coverage_notes.result_summary: Official CMS checked first followed by 12 targeted searches. No new, substantively verified, nonduplicate qualifying U.S./territorial healthcare-access change identified during the observation window.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded supplementary recall, not an exhaustive national or territorial survey. Search result ranking heavily favored older/out-of-scope stories, so newly reported local changes could be missed due to reporting or indexing lag. Lack of new verified findings does not prove no access changes occurred.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one new private append-only watch heartbeat; no approvals, production publication, schedule changes, or task disabling.
